g.text: Reading the answer against decoding it, same model, same prompt, one NVIDIA A40
A Jevified answer is the prefill alone: the prompt goes through once and every allowed answer's probability is read from the last position. Decoding the same
answer as text pays the prefill and then one decoder step per token (Hugging Face eager, greedy). A one-word answer is a wash; anything longer is not.
